quick_notes.title: Coding & Series Recap
quick_notes.detail: EJOTY (5-25). Opposites (AZ, BY). Pattern : Squares, Primes, +n/-n.
quick_notes.explanation: In coding and series problems, you need to know alphabet positions. Use EJOTY, where the letters E, J, O, T, Y are at positions 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 in the alphabet – this helps you count by fives. Opposites are pairs of letters whose position numbers add to 27, such as A (1) and Z (26), B (2) and Y (25), and so on. Series patterns often use square numbers (like 1, 4, 9, 16, which are a number times itself), prime numbers (like 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, which have only two factors: 1 and itself), or adding or subtracting a constant value, written as +n or -n.

quick_notes.title: Syllogism & Venn Recap
quick_notes.detail: All (Inside), Some (Overlap). Conclusion must be definite. Animals/Tiger/Lion Venn.
quick_notes.explanation: A syllogism is a way of reasoning where you use two or more statements to figure out whether a third statement, called a conclusion, is definitely true. We use Venn diagrams, which are overlapping circles, to show the relationships between different groups, such as "animals," "tigers," and "lions." When a statement says "All tigers are animals," it means the entire circle of "tigers" must be drawn completely inside the circle of "animals." When a statement says "Some tigers are lions," it means the circles for "tigers" and "lions" must overlap, sharing a common area. A conclusion is only correct if it must be true in every possible way you can draw the diagram without breaking the given statements. For example, from "All tigers are animals" and "All lions are animals," you cannot conclude that "Some tigers are lions" because the tiger and lion circles might not overlap at all.

quick_notes.title: Relation & Direction Recap
quick_notes.detail: Tree (+/-, : , |). Direction : N-S-E-W. Pythagoras for shortest distance.
quick_notes.explanation: In Staff Selection Commission (SSC) reasoning problems, you will learn two topics: blood relations and direction sense. For blood relations, a plus sign (+) means male, a minus sign (-) means female, a colon (:) means married to, and a vertical bar (|) connects parents to their children. For direction sense, the four cardinal directions are North (N), South (S), East (E), and West (W). To find the shortest straight-line distance between two points after moving in perpendicular directions, use the Pythagorean theorem: square the distance traveled north-south and the distance traveled east-west, add them, then take the square root.

quick_notes.detail: Circle Inside: Right: Anti. Linear : Left/Right of paper. Start with definite info.
quick_notes.explanation: Seating arrangement puzzles are problems where you place people in a circle or a straight line based on given clues. In a circular arrangement, if people are facing inside toward the center, then a person's right side is the anticlockwise direction (the direction opposite to the way a clock's hands move). quick_notes.title: Visual & Analytical Recap
quick_notes.detail: Mirror (L/R flip). Water (U/D flip). Assumption (Before). Conclusion (After).
quick_notes.explanation: A mirror reflection creates a left-right flip, meaning the left side of an object appears on the right side of the image. A water reflection creates an up-down flip, where the top of an object appears at the bottom of the image. In reasoning, an assumption is the unstated idea you accept as true before you start an argument, while a conclusion is the final statement you reach after applying logic to that assumption. For example, if you assume all birds can fly and you see a sparrow, your conclusion is that the sparrow can fly.
